# Steam — Naxyň's FPS/font fix and retirement note

- Original source: [Steam — Naxyň's FPS/font fix and retirement note](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2227664168)
- Author / publication: Naxyň / Steam Community
- Language / date: English body; posted 2020-09-13, updated 2025-04-18
- Access: Guide body and visible comments inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The author describes a replacement package using files from the original CD release to address low frame rates and restore the original font. The current title marks the guide outdated, and the introduction says a publisher patch now runs at 22 FPS on Windows 10/11.

Comments distinguish the game's comparatively slow normal cadence from severe degradation to around two frames per second. Thus, a report of sluggishness alone does not identify the same fault.

The publisher-fix claim is the guide author's statement; no Steam build comparison was performed. The record preserves both the earlier workaround and the later status change.
